description: Sanitized deterministic regressions from the 2026-09-05 engineering audit.

cases.description: The plugin must not replace native worktree creation with a notification hook.
An automatic Astra fallback requires an invocation-scoped escalation grant.
Conditional approval text must not become an approving vote.
A tool-loop provider receives its selected credential but no ambient sentinel.
A timed-out shell cannot leave a descendant that writes after return.
Codex credential selection follows the active provider rather than table order.
A completion replaces its reservation and duplicate completion is idempotent.
The npm allowlist includes command files required by the plugin manifest.
An exact Claude SDK Haiku seat cannot inherit the generic one-million-token ceiling.
